rows.Main Input: target-sample measured spatial transcriptomics matrix with region context
rows.Main Output: same-resolution denoised or imputed expression matrix
rows.Key Difference: Detects molecular regions from spatial-expression structure before low-rank imputation, making region context explicit rather than relying on image features or deep generative models.
rows.Evidence Note: PubMed/DOI verify the Nature Communications method paper and the paper reports official code availability. Comparator and scale labels are Layer 2 synthesis. Code access is trace metadata only and does not imply execution readiness or backend/environment binding availability.
rows.Best First Choice When: Consider when the task is same-resolution denoising, smoothing, filtering, or measured-coordinate signal recovery.
rows.Do Not Start With This When: Do not use when the task asks for missing/unmeasured gene prediction, histology-to-expression prediction, or finer-geometry super-resolution.
rows.Signal-risk Caveat: Recovered, smoothed, denoised, or reconstructed values remain model-processed signals; do not interpret them as new direct measurements or as unmeasured-gene prediction unless the method explicitly supports that branch.
